o.norm: a bit of a back door in!
checks expected order, and the + indicates that element had a next sibling at time of emission

i.norm: Verifies that {@link StreamParser} progressively emits XML elements in document order when streaming, and that each element is complete (children included) with its next (empty) sibling present at the time it is emitted.

Appends a compact, human-readable signature of {@code el} to {@code trace}, capturing the facts this test cares about for each emitted element:
  • the tag name,
  • {@code #id} when the element has an {@code id} attribute,
  • {@code [text]} when the element has its own (non-child) text,
  • a trailing {@code +} when the element already has a next sibling at emission time.
Each signature is terminated with {@code ;}.
Record every element as it is streamed, in emission order.
Elements are emitted in document order as each is closed, so children precede their parents. A trailing "+" marks elements that already had a next sibling when emitted.
